description:
Redeem 3.0 | 20'' Kids BMX Bike

Vacuum Coating - Attractive colors which adds extra fun.
Double U-brake & Wide 20 x 2.35" Tires - Ensure your kid's safety.

360 ° Rotor & 4 Pegs - Increase the way of riding and have fun.
3/5-Spoke Wheel - Reduced wind resistance and increased strength .

Vacuum Coating

Vacuum coating color, as a special technique from Hiland, is cool when riding and adds extra fun. It can also resist to any dirty kinds of environment.

High-strength steel frame and components are rugged and built to last.

Excellent Safety

Redeem 3.0 equips non-slip double U-brake system, which makes your kids safer when doing 360-degree performance.

Wide 20 x 2.35 inch tires which is thicker than other kid's bikes, have a great grip even on uneven roads.

Professional Functionality

The handlebar and fork are joined by a stem, 360 ° rotor allow you to turn the handlebar completely. Plus, 4 pegs allow kids to try hops and tricks easily, which makes the riding more entertaining.

The 3-spoke / 5-spoke wheel reduces wind resistance and improves wheel strength.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, free pedals and required assembly tools included, easy to assemble.
* Since BMX is 360-degree rotation, it has different brake design. Please watch the brake assemble video carefully after receiving the bike to get good braking effect and safety, also you can adjust the brake cable to prevent too tight or too loose.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Vacuum Coating

Hiland special oil slick color is cool and resist to any dirty kinds of environment. Also, built to last with a rugged hi-ten steel frame and components.

3/5-Spoke Wheel

Reduced wind resistance and increased strength with a more stylish appearance.

360° Rotor

360 ° rotor allows riders to turn the handlebar completely which makes the riding more entertaining.

4 Pegs

4 pegs in the front and back allow kids to try hops and tricks easily.

Elevate your street style with the Hiland Redeem 3.0. This 20-inch freestyle BMX features a 360° rotor, 4 pegs, and a stunning vacuum-coated finish. Perfect for beginner to intermediate riders.
